changes.name: EnergyUI
changes.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "EnergyUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name = "EnergyCounter"
frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 18)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 230, 0, 64)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 30, 42)
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
corner.Parent = frame

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Thickness = 2
stroke.Transparency = 0.2
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(95, 190, 255)
stroke.Parent = frame

local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)
icon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 1, 0)
icon.Text = "⚡"
icon.TextSize = 31
icon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
icon.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80)
icon.Parent = frame

local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 62, 0, 5)
label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -74, 0, 23)
label.Text = "ENERGY"
label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
label.TextSize = 15
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(155, 205, 255)
label.Parent = frame

local amount = Instance.new("TextLabel")
amount.BackgroundTransparency = 1
amount.Position = UDim2.new(0, 62, 0, 26)
amount.Size = UDim2.new(1, -74, 0, 31)
amount.Text = "0"
amount.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
amount.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
amount.TextSize = 26
amount.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
amount.Parent = frame

local stats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats")
local energy = stats:WaitForChild("Energy")

local function update()
	amount.Text = tostring(energy.Value)
end

energy:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(update)
update()
